Method of Attack: botnet controlling Windows PCs for cryptocurrency mining, stealing user credentials and cookies, deploying proxies on Windows systems and IoT devices
Attack Vector: traffic purchased from traffic distribution systems (TDS) camouflaged as free downloadable software, videos, or movies
Indicators of Compromise: selling access to virtual machines loaded with stolen credentials (dont.farm)
selling credit card numbers (extracard) to be used for other malicious activities such as serving malicious ads and payment fraud on Google Ads
